howToUse.aboutBody: GT is built on a simple idea: most people have never really seen their own country. We built a way to discover real places in Cameroon — matched to what you actually like, planned with friends, and rewarded the more you explore.
howToUse.step1Body: Sign up with an email, a phone number, or Google — whichever's easiest. Verify it within 30 minutes and you're in.
howToUse.step2Body: Search by name, type, budget, or how far something is from you. Every result is a real place, shown on a real map.
howToUse.step3Body: Your recommendations page learns from the preferences you set — the more specific, the better the matches.
howToUse.step4Body: Pick destinations, set your dates, and keep every trip you're planning in one place under My Trips.
howToUse.step5Body: Use the app for at least 5 minutes a day and earn $0.50 — tracked automatically, shown on your profile in USD and FCFA.
howToUse.step6Body: Share your referral link from your profile. Every friend who joins and verifies their account earns you a bonus too.
howToUse.step7Body: Rate a place, report an issue, or suggest something — your feedback shapes what GT recommends next, and counts toward payout eligibility.
howToUse.noInvestment: No investment. No catch. Just exploring.
howToUse.freeToUse: GT is free to use. The rewards come from staying active and inviting people you trust.
